reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for migration from ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft has been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Clusters still ZooKeeper-based must be migrated to KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer, because ZooKeeper support and the migration path are removed.
consequence.remediation: Migrate all clusters to KRaft using a Strimzi version that still supports migration, then upgrade to 0.46.0 or newer.

proposed.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removes support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration, so all clusters must already be on KRaft before upgrading to 0.46.0 or newer.
